result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but one clear visual defect stands out: the hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' fails to load and shows a generic broken-image placeholder icon on an empty gray block. A couple of minor contrast/consistency issues are also noted. Carousel clipping at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a broken/missing image: a large empty light-gray rectangle with a generic 'broken image' glyph in the center, while all other restaurant cards show real food imagery. This makes the primary promoted listing look unfinished and unappetizing.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading pipeline for this restaurant and add a graceful fallback (branded placeholder, blurred cuisine illustration, or solid brand-color tile with the restaurant name) instead of the raw broken-image icon. Also add lazy-load retry/error handling so failed images never render the system placeholder glyph.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the image-less card is a mid-gray circle with a white outline heart, giving it noticeably weaker contrast than the same control on the pizza card below (dark translucent circle). On the light gray placeholder it is easy to miss.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent dark translucent scrim (e.g. rgba(0,0,0,0.45)) behind the heart icon on all cards, regardless of whether the image loaded, to keep the affordance visible and consistent.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is rendered in a very light gray on a light gray field, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio needed for readable text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color (e.g. #6B7280 or darker) so it meets WCAG AA contrast against the field background, and ensure the field has an accessible label.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the delivery-time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit at the bottom-left overlapping the food imagery, and on the first card the badge covers part of the plate, slightly obscuring the dish.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scrim or padding behind the ETA badge, or position it consistently in a corner with enough margin so it does not cover the main subject of the photo.
